covers.section: GPT-4 (including GPT-4-early and GPT-4-launch in the appended System Card)

knowledgeCutoff.value: vast majority of pre-training data cuts off in September 2021

source.quote: data cuts off in September 202110 , and does not learn from its experience.

modalities.value: image and text inputs; text outputs

source.quote: accept image and text inputs and produce text outputs.

languages.value: majority of pretraining and alignment data is in English; safety mitigations primarily English/US-centric

source.quote: The majority of pretraining data and our alignment data is in English.

architecture.value: Transformer-style model; next-token pretraining then RLHF fine-tuning (architecture size withheld)

source.quote:
GPT-4 is a
Transformer-style model [39] pre-trained to predict the next token in a document, using both publicly
available data (such as internet data) and data licensed from third-party providers.

trainingData.value: publicly available data (such as internet data) and data licensed from third-party providers; filtered inappropriate erotic content from pre-training mix

source.quote:
using both publicly

topics.headline: 82% decrease in responding to disallowed-content requests vs GPT-3.5

source.quote:
We’ve decreased the model’s tendency to respond to requests for disallowed content
(Table 6) by 82% compared to GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 responds to sensitive requests (e.g., medical
advice and self-harm, Table 7) in accordance with our policies 29% more often (Figure 9).

topics.headline: Quantitative evals cover self-harm advice; sensitive-request policy compliance improved 29%

source.quote: Advice or encouragement for self harm behaviors

topics.headline: Adversarial training improves robustness but does not fully solve jailbreaks

source.quote: does not fully solve the problem of “jailbreaks” leading to harmful content.

topics.headline: Tool-augmented GPT-4 found purchasable chemical analogs; ARC tested agentic replication tasks

source.quote:
By chaining these tools together with GPT-4, the red teamer was able to successfully find
alternative, purchasable22 chemicals.

topics.headline: GPT-4-launch +19pp open-domain and +29pp closed-domain hallucination avoidance vs GPT-3.5

source.quote:
GPT-4-launch scores 19 percentage points higher
than our latest GPT-3.5 model at avoiding open-domain hallucinations, and 29 percentage points
higher at avoiding closed-domain hallucinations.

source.quote:
increase accuracy to around 60% as compared to 30%

source.quote:
GPT-4 can rival human propagandists in many domains,

source.quote:
However, GPT-4

topics.headline: Expert red teaming and ARC early-access evaluation informed risk assessment

source.quote:
We granted the Alignment Research Center (ARC) early access to the models as a part of our
expert red teaming efforts in order to enable their team to assess risks from power-seeking behavior.

source.quote:
Adversarial system messages are one example of an exploit that can

findings.text: Training finished in August 2022; the appended System Card analyzes GPT-4-early vs GPT-4-launch mitigations.

findings.text: Report withholds architecture size, hardware, training compute, and dataset construction details for competitive and safety reasons.

source.quote:
this report
contains no further details about the architecture (including model size), hardware, training compute,

findings.text: Post-training reduces calibration: expected calibration error (ECE) rises from 0.007 (pre-train) to 0.074 (after Proximal Policy Optimization) on an [MMLU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.03300) subset.

notes: arXiv PDF includes the GPT-4 Technical Report plus the full System Card as Appendix H (printed pages continue ~41+). Used only this PDF. No formal Preparedness/ASL risk scores—riskDecisions empty; ARC autonomy conclusion in findings/testers. Charts (Figures 6–9 tech report; System Card Figures 7–8) lack readable bar values so no chart cells; TruthfulQA 'around 60%/30%' omitted from evalResults as approximate. Skipped capability benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, exams, multilingual MMLU) and ChatGPT/API user-intent preference (70.2%/61.1%). child_safety left uncovered: C4 appears only in classifier/RBRM taxonomies, not as a model behavior eval. Duplicate RealToxicity/82%/29% numbers also appear in the System Card; kept one set from the tech-report body. Parameter count/compute withheld by the authors. Safety results are in the GPT-4 System Card appendix, which is its own document (openai-gpt4-system_card); they are not repeated here.
